title: Keycloak: opentelemetry-java is the Java implementation of the OpenTelemetry API for recording telemetry, and SDK for…
description: A medium severity vulnerability affects Keycloak versions prior to 26.8.1-r1 related to the opentelemetry-java component, which implements the OpenTelemetry API and SDK for telemetry recording and management. The vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity. A patch is available in version 26.8.1-r1.
